caption: The Dashboard of Track123 with a green bar Your tracking page is generated successfully. (the link of the tracking page is hidden; buttons View and Customize), a blue note Can I remove Track123 brand in my tracking page? (Contact support to verify your store in order to remove the branding from your tracking page.), a plan bar Starter with a full bar, the counters Exception 0, Failed attempt 0 and Pending 0, and above it a note about a Partner Program. The store name in the left menu and in the link of the tracking page is hidden.

The Customize editor of the page Track order status (Default) with the Traditional Theme and the sections Order lookup, Progress bar and Tracking details, a greyed Shipment review widget and greyed Product recommendation and Instagram feed with the word Upgrade. The preview shows a sample shipment with the status Delivered: a progress bar Ordered Aug 7, Order Ready Aug 8, In Transit Aug 9, Out for Delivery Aug 16 and Delivered Aug 16, Shipping Details with FedEx scans (Evanston, IL and Niles, IL), a map with Current Location, and Package Contents Purple Dress x2 with a button Reorder. A bar at the top says Store header will appear on the live store. This is a sample, not a real parcel, and nothing was saved. The store icon in the left strip, the product picture in Package Contents and a small picture on the map are hidden.

The Billing page of Track123 with the box Starter (Available/Total 50 / 50, Quota reset date: Dec 17, 2026), the switch Monthly (selected) and Annual (20% OFF), and four plan columns: Starter Free with Orders per month 50 and Unavailable after quota is exceeded (Current plan), Growth $9 a month with Orders per month 300 and $0.05 per extra order (Start 7-day free trial), Advanced (RECOMMENDED) $49 a month with Orders per month 2,000 and $0.05 per extra order (Start 7-day free trial) and Enterprise Custom with Orders per month 100,000+ and $0.05 per extra order (Contact Us). The first features of Starter (Branded tracking page, Access to 1500+ carriers, Auto shipment import, Shopify native email notification) are listed. The store name in the left menu is hidden.

The Shopify screen Approve subscription for the app Track123 with the note This app bills you for a recurring subscription and usage charges, the plan Growth Plan, subscription details $9,00 USD every 30 days, an App spending limit (charged based on use, to a maximum of $30,00 USD per 30 days, which can be updated after approval), a row Add payment method, and on the right Your next bill: You have a 7-day free trial ending on 24 Nov., Subtotal $9,00 plus any applicable taxes (the subtotal contains only the subscription fee, usage is charged on top), Total $9,00 Due 24 Nov, and a greyed Approve button. The screen has no sentence about a test charge. Nothing was approved; the screen was left with Cancel. The store name in the left menu is hidden.
